svg.title: Molecule of the day: Haloperidol
svg.desc: A rotating 3D structure of Haloperidol while a graph neural network predicts its lipophilicity (logD) as 2.67.
svg.text: MW 375.9 · cLogP 4.43 · TPSA 40.5 · HBD 1 · HBA 3 · RotB 6
3-layer message-passing GNN · 4,200 molecules · held-out RMSE 0.603 (R² 0.731) · descriptors from RDKit
